feeds.title: Physics-Based Animation
feeds.description: This site is dedicated to accumulating and highlighting research in the exciting field of physics-based animation for computer graphics. In general, the topics that I usually include are rigid bodies, deformable bodies, cloth, articulated bodies, collision detection, meshing, shells, hair, liquids, gases/smoke, explosions, fracture, and the list goes on.

feeds.title: National Film Board of Canada Blog » Animation
feeds.description: Explore our vast collection of animated films and get info about the world of animation in general. NFB.ca is the National Film Board of Canada's award-winning online Screening Room, featuring over 5,000 productions.

feeds.title: EnDesign Blog
feeds.description: Read EnDesign's blog posts on different ways to use virtual reality as a tool for your business and common uses of 3D animation & steps to 3D rendering. EnDesign was established in 2013 in Toronto, Ontario and our specialties include 3D visualizations and commercial renderings, 3D animations, Show Reel, 3D AR & VR, Architectural Visualizations services, and more.

feeds.title: Al's Animations Blog
feeds.description: I'm Al Sande, a fairly-recently retired accountant, and college business instructor. I've been making videos for over a decade now and have made quite a few gold mining and time-lapse videos of both area drives and weather/clouds. Now I'm venturing off into the world of 3d modeling, animation, and CGI with Blender, an amazing open-source tool.

feeds.title: de kunst
feeds.description: Carla Morris is a Hamilton-based animation filmmaker, storyboard, and stop-motion artist. Her blog posts feature write-ups on animation, illustrations, sketching, and more.

feeds.title: Canadian Animation Blog
feeds.description: A blog created to celebrate animation through interviews, photos, and event coverage. The blog provides an online showcase for Canadian artists, animation, and events.

feeds.title: Cartoon North
feeds.description: Cartoon North was founded in 2008 as Canadian Animation Resources. The goal then, as it is now, is to bring together the Canadian Animation community in a positive and meaningful way, and to provide access to jobs, news, and other resources.

feeds.title: Dream Farm Studios Blog
feeds.description: Access the latest 3D animation and CG world news and articles at Dream Farm animation studios blog. Dream Farm is a creative studio that creates Animation and Game art for broadcast and the web with a strong focus on well-designed characters. We are a character-driven animation studio creating both 3D and 2D animation series for a wide range of applications in the entertainment industry.

feeds.title: Toon Boom Animation Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest news from Toon Boom Animation in our Newsfeed. With years of incomparable experience, Toon Boom's award-winning software is the global standard for animation and storyboarding. Our mission at Toon Boom is to build innovative software solutions that provide powerful storyboarding, offer animation capabilities and streamline the production process for artists, studios, and students.

feeds.title: Emily Carr Animation Blog
feeds.description: Emily Carr Animation blog features articles that will help you to develop a top-notch range of skills to support comprehensive animation production at an industry and personal practice level. We are located in Vancouver, BC, a world-destination and international city centre for education, art, culture, design, nature, and media industry.

feeds.title: Think Tank News & Updates
feeds.description: Stay up to date on the latest VFX and animation news and get access to student interviews for an inside look at our animation school. Think Tank Training Centre is Canada's premiere 3D modeling and animation school. We are dedicated to providing training that will ensure a realistic opportunity for employment.

feeds.title: Quote The Anime Blog
feeds.description: QuoteTheAnime is a website that was created to create creative, curated content that motivates individuals. We strive to provide the most enthusiastic, interesting, creative, and exciting content that provides inspiration to Anime Lovers, which is truly the reason why we watch anime in the first place.
